finding: The k-correction does not improve on the Baseline: with S_sgs = 0, no positive transfer velocity can match most samples, and the retained correction saturates near zero (median k_eff/k_emp = 0.09446). Residual-AI keeps k_emp but does not beat the Baseline on C_aq and extrapolates to unphysical sources. S_sgs and k are not jointly identifiable from concentration alone.
